I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025. It was the Tier 2 escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan, and he confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is something he could see himself.

There's also a ticket called PD-88412, but it belongs to another account (Thornbury Cloth) and isn't this one. Separately, ticket #4912 covers a different Door 6 problem at Tansleigh's Marietta plant, a phantom lock rather than a freeze. That ticket only appears in an email I couldn't confirm Hollis can see, so I didn't mention it to him.
